prompt:
CRITICAL ANTI-TEXT DIRECTIVE: ZERO text of ANY kind. No letters, words, numbers, runes, hieroglyphs, symbols, watermarks, logos, or inscriptions. All decorative markings are abstract geometric fracture patterns only.

Create a tactical RPG map background for The Gate Judgment — the universal trial arena in Mythos Gates: Ascension. This is the entry point for ALL players regardless of chosen deity faction.

CONCEPT: A vast circular arena carved into ancient Gate stone, split into three concentric rings. The arena exists in a neutral dimension between all seven Realms — a wound in reality where the Gate tests those who would pass.

OUTER RING: Wide stone entry platform with crumbling ancient Gate-stone tiles. Faint fracture cracks glowing with white energy. Sparse cover pillars of weathered grey stone. This is where players learn movement.

MIDDLE RING: Elevated platform with faction-colored light channels running through the floor (neutral grey stone base with subtle energy veins). Abstract geometric mechanisms embedded in walls — rotating stone panels, pressure plates suggested by circular indentations. A healing shrine (glowing white orb on a stone pedestal) bridges middle and inner rings.

INNER RING: Raised central dais where the Gate stone is most concentrated. Dark charcoal-black stone with intense white fracture cracks radiating outward. The center is a depression where the Hollow Wretch boss emerges. The Gate itself looms behind — a massive cracked archway of impossible scale, bleeding white light through its fractures, with fragments of all seven faction aesthetics barely visible in its stonework (Egyptian gold, Norse iron, Greek marble, Shinto lacquer, Celtic wood, Empyrean ivory, Infernal black iron — all blended, none dominant).

ATMOSPHERE: Grim dark, solemn, ancient. Neutral grey-charcoal stone dominant. White energy fractures providing cold light. No faction color dominance — this is the Gate neutral zone. Dust particles drifting in pale light. The arena feels like it has existed since before the deities themselves.

STYLE: Premium dark fantasy tactical RPG map background. Isometric/2.5D perspective suitable for mobile tactical grid. Rich textures, dramatic lighting, atmospheric depth. Painted illustration style matching the Mythos Gates visual language. No characters in the map — empty arena ready for combat.

ZERO text, ZERO lettering, ZERO numbers, ZERO symbols of any kind. Abstract fracture patterns only.
